title: mcp/list_open_pairs/v1
description: The result of the list_open_pairs tool (F26-T10, R8; D-9, D-28 v3.39): every open direction of every pair/v1 record under targets/<id>/review/pairs/ — the two candidates, the direction, the last attempt recorded or null, its target_id, and submit_as: pair-proof, the artifact type a proof or refutation of it goes through submit_proof as — in the records' order: nothing is ranked (D-25), and an open direction is work on a review, never a frontier entry (F26-Q6). Every value is an id, an enum or the gate's own attempt record, so nothing is demarcated. Or an error result naming the source that did not answer, or the filter refused (R10).

read_at.description: The commit of main the graph was read at, or the branch name when the service could not learn its head (F05-T13).

target_id.description: The target filter as given; null for every target.

direction.description: forward: a implies b; backward: b implies a.

attempt.description: The last attempt recorded while open (who, tool, budget_s), or null.

submit_as.description: The artifact type a proof or refutation of the direction is submitted as, through submit_proof.

oneOf.description: The plain path did not answer, or the arguments were refused (F09-R10)
